mapper.sql: u.id, u.nick_name, u.head_img, u.phone_number, u.third_party_name, u.level_name, u.level_value, u.level_date,u.birthday, u.email, u.voc_count_of_day, u.has_sign_card
mapper.select: select, lp.privilege_code from user u left join level l on u.level_value >= l.level_value left join level_privilege lp on l.id=lp.level_id where u.id=#{userId} and l.is_deleted=0 and (lp.is_deleted=0 or lp.is_deleted is null)
select l.level_value, check_in_days, check_in_type from level l where l.level_value = (select level_value + 1 from user u where u.id = #{userId}) and l.is_deleted=0

select l.id , l.level_name , l.level_value , l.check_in_days , l.check_in_type , l.unlock_price , l.description , lp.id lp_id , lp.level_id , lp.image_name , lp.description lp_desc , lp.privilege_code , lp.privilege_name , lp.use_type , lp.free_count from level l left join level_privilege lp on l.id = lp.level_id where l.is_deleted = 0 and lp.is_deleted = 0

select count(*) as count from voc_chap_book vcb inner join user_voc_rev uvc on vcb.book_id = #{bookId} and vcb.voc_id = uvc.voc_id where uvc.user_id = #{userId} and uvc.is_deleted = 0 and vcb.is_deleted = 0

select bc.voc_id, bc.voc_name as content, if(uvr.voc_id is null, 0, 1) reviewed, if(unr.voc_id is null, 0, 1) not_remember, vm.id as mid, vm.type, vm.inter_content from (select vcb.voc_id, vcb.voc_name, vcb.is_deleted from voc_chap_book vcb where vcb.book_id = #{bookId} and is_deleted = 0
) bc left join voc_meaning vm on vm.voc_id = bc.voc_id and vm.is_deleted = 0 left join user_voc_rev uvr on uvr.user_id = #{userId} and uvr.voc_id = bc.voc_id and uvr.is_deleted = 0 left join user_not_remember unr on unr.user_id = #{userId} and unr.voc_id = bc.voc_id and unr.is_deleted = 0
